sectionDescription: From sandbox to stage—choose the path that fits your musical journey.

programs.title: ROCK CLASS
programs.subtitle: The Sandbox Sessions
programs.description: The entry point—a low-pressure, high-energy environment for musicians to find their footing. Weekly guided group sessions where adaptability is key.
features: Learn to adapt—"Play the hand you're dealt"

programs.title: ROCK BAND
programs.subtitle: The Flagship Program
programs.description: For musicians ready to commit. A dual-track mentorship designed to take you from solitary practice to a headline performance on The Underground's main stage.
features: Culminates in a ticketed showcase concert
Selected based on talent, drive & chemistry
